title: Ned Finds a Soft Spot
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 76-sound stage (ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling arriving at the open door of a wooden garden shed.

pages.text: A shelf in the shed is a mess.
pages.illustration: A wooden shelf inside the shed cluttered with pots and rags.

pages.text: Ned sets the pots on the shelf.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling using his bill to nudge small pots into a neat row on the shelf.

pages.text: Ned felt the soft rag on the shelf.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling pressing one webbed foot gently on a soft rag.
Ned the duckling nudging a wobbly shelf bracket back into place with his bill.

pages.text: Ned sets the rag on top.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling folding the soft rag neatly on top of the shelf.
The tidy wooden shelf, pots in a row and a folded rag on top.
Ned the duckling standing back, pleased with the tidy shelf.

pages.text: Ned naps on the soft rag at last.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling curled up asleep on the soft folded rag.
